subject: Tenant admin handoff and API key seeding — Everwell onboarding
messages:
From: Claire Ng <claire.ng@everwell.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Everwell IT <it@everwell.io>
Date: 2026-08-26T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Everwell tenant + initial admin list

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — excited to get started. Per our call, we want to get the initial tenant set up this week so our SRE and app teams can run smoke tests. Attaching the list of folks we want seeded as org admins.

Quick questions:
- We prefer to use our own KMS (AWS KMS) for production keys. Is customer-managed KMS supported for initial seeding or does Redwood require Redwood-managed keys for the first 30 days?
- Can you confirm whether initial API keys are long-lived or rotated to ephemeral creds during the first week?

Attached: everwell-admins.csv (names + emails + role), sample network allowlist.

Also suggest a short handoff call with your onboarding engineer and our SRE to confirm project names and role mapping. Are you available Friday morning PST?

Claire Ng
Head of Integrations
Everwell Health
[Attachment: everwell-admins.csv (CSV)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ng <claire.ng@everwell.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-26T15:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Everwell tenant + initial admin list

Hi Claire — great to meet you yesterday and thanks for sending the admin list. Looping in Monica (CS implementation) and Aditya (onboarding infra) to kick off the handoff.

Answers up front:
- Customer-managed KMS: supported. For production we strongly recommend Everwell KMS (we support AWS KMS and GCP KMS). For the very first smoke test we can seed temporary Redwood-managed keys if you prefer to avoid IAM work in the first 24 hours.
- Initial API keys: we will provision one short-lived service key for bootstrap (48 hours) and then seed a pair of long-lived admin API keys scoped to the "platform-admin" project. Those long-lived keys are intended for the first 30 days and we’ll run an automated rotation schedule thereafter. We will also provide a sample automation script for rotation.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm whether you want Redwood to create the initial project namespace names or provide your preferred names (we can map your internal envs to Redwood projects).
2) Confirm KMS choice (Everwell AWS KMS ARN if customer-managed).
3) Schedule 30-minute technical handoff with SRE + Aditya + Monica (propose Fri 8/28 09:00 PST).

Attaching the Redwood onboarding checklist and a sample config to show the exact fields we need.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Customer Success (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-onboard-checklist.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: sample-config.yaml (YAML)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-26T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Everwell handoff — action items

Team — quick internal note following Claire's email. Proposed split:
- Aditya: provision tenant namespace, create bootstrap service key (48h), set project names per Claire if provided.
- Rishi: own admin seed approvals and KMS confirmation, coordinate Docs/HubSpot updates.
- Monica: implementation runbook and invite cadence; own the onboarding checklist and follow-up emails.

I will prepare the mutual action plan (MAP) and share it in the Drive folder. We should also confirm whether Everwell wants RBAC roles beyond Admin/Dev/Observer (they indicated SRE + App). If they want finer roles, we should capture those on the call.

I'll draft the calendar invite for Fri 08/28 09:00 PST and include the tool-specific checklist.

Monica
Senior Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Ng <claire.ng@everwell.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Everwell IT <it@everwell.io>
Date: 2026-08-27T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Everwell tenant + initial admin list

Thanks — confirmed for the Friday slot. A few clarifications:
- KMS: we'll use our AWS KMS key. ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Please confirm the minimum IAM permissions you need to read the key (we will provide a cross-account role if required).
- Project names: please create "everwell-prod" and "everwell-staging" namespaces.
- RBAC: seed the following roles: SRE (full admin on infra resources), AppOwner (deploy + model config), Observer (read-only). I'll include emails in the CSV for mapping.

Also uploading signed PO in a DocuSign envelope (link below) — we aim to have billing effective by 9/1.

Claire
[Attachment: everwell-signed-po.pdf (PDF)]
[DocuSign: https://docusign.com/transaction/ABC-9482]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ng <claire.ng@everwell.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-27T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Everwell tenant + initial admin list

Claire — thanks for the ARN and for confirming project names. Actioning now:
- Aditya will provision namespaces everwell-prod and everwell-staging and create the 48h bootstrap key.
- We'll configure cross-account IAM role for KMS read/Decrypt as documented in our KMS integration guide. Please share the role ARN when available and we'll test key access in the Friday call.
- I've updated the HubSpot deal and attached the onboarding checklist to the deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765.

Deliverables for Friday call (08/28 09:00 PST):
- Everwell: confirm role-to-email mappings (CSV).
- Redwood: initial namespace provisioned, bootstrap key active, sample rotate script, and policy doc for KMS access.

I put the working docs in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboard-everwell. Monica — can you publish the MAP in that folder and add the invite?

Thanks,
Rishi
[Attachment: redwood-policy-kms-integration.md (TXT)]

- Tenant namespaces created: everwell-prod, everwell-staging (pending final tags).
- Bootstrap key: created, TTL 48h, token printed to secure vault (will share ephemeral access on call).
- Sample-config.yaml updated with project IDs and RBAC groups.
- Added a note to the MAP: require Everwell to confirm cross-account role by EOD Thursday so we can test KMS access in the call.

Drive runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboard-everwell (MAP and runbook under /runbooks/everwell-implementation.md)
